description:
Design how a user-built scenario gets packaged and proposed upstream. Covers: what files are in scope (full scenario directory), what scenarios are even eligible (general-purpose vs personal/private), licensing and attribution, where proposals land (a separate scenario-proposals repo? a labeled issue? a discussion?), and the review path on your side (likely goes through contribution-triage + isolated verification).

Deliverable: conclusion.md with the scenario-proposal artifact contract.
name: scenario-proposal-artifact-design
title: Design scenario-proposal artifact type for outbound submissions
